newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares up as OMV continues advance.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares up as OMV continues advance.

text.p: Austrian shares closed 0.8 percent up on Wednesday, bolstered by selective demand for oil firm OMV and fireproof materials manufacturer Radex-Heraklith, and traders forecast a consolidation after Thursday's holiday.
The blue-chip ATX index closed 9.74 points up at 1,227.21 with 11 shares as gainers, nine losers and one unchanged.

"Given a neutral international environment the market should consolidate on Friday or perhaps ease a little," a trader said, adding that shares going ex-dividend could increase downward pressure in the coming week.
A speech by Federal Reserve chief Alan Greenspan on Thursday would attract keen interest from market participants looking for clues on U.S. interest rates, dealers added.
ATX heavywieght OMV set the pace, adding on 4.44 percent or 61 schillings to finish at 1,448. The company reported a good set of first quarter earnings at the start of the week.
Radex, fresh from an investor relations tour of the United States, rose 2.88 percent or 14 schillings to 500.

Vienna airport company Flughafen Wien was the leading decliner, shedding 4.29 percent or 22 schillings to 497. Traders said the stock had come under selling pressure from U.S. and British investors and noted a drop below 493 schillings could trigger further losses.
May ATX futures were 10.6 points up at 1,220.6. The broad-based Vienna bourse index rose 2.6 points to 460.78. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
